verdict.rationale: The API docs mention filtering chats "created by scheduled prompts", which implies Limitless has its own scheduled-prompt feature that runs AI tasks on a schedule rather than only interactively. However, that is the only mention: there are no docs on configuring schedules, and nothing on triggering tasks from external events. The read/delete Developer API and the MCP server are data-access building blocks, not event triggers. missing for 10: first-party documentation of how scheduled prompts are created and configured, any external-event or webhook trigger mechanism, scheduling of pendant/device-level tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
